A '''Miniature rail cannon''', also known as a '''miniature rail gun''' was a small [[Railgun/Legends|Rail gun]] produced by [[Tac-Spec Corporation]].

A stock weapon integrated into [[FIII Footman droid]]s, the miniature rail cannon was no larger than half a human hand. Firing small metal projectiles using electromagnetic force, the resultant projectile was super-accelerated to deal kinetic force out of proportion with its small size; all in a manner similar to the more popular and well known [[Verpine shatter gun]]s. Despite this however, the projectiles dealt far less damage than the infamous shatter gun counterparts - being able to be stopped by heavy armor. Additionally, they left tracers and produced muzzle flash like other rail guns.

A common upgrade to the stock miniature rail gun, was the [[Mini rail cannon|Rika/Moab mini rail cannon]].
